generation.prompt: Create a premium photorealistic 960×960 autumn landscape intended as a collectible seasonal special image for the Afterchime app. A rugged Appalachian-style mountain ridge sits in the far background beneath a quiet, lightly clouded late-afternoon sky. In the foreground and along both side edges, mature deciduous trees carry rich but natural fall foliage—burnt orange, copper, russet, muted crimson, and touches of ochre—with a few fallen leaves and tall dry grasses. A harvested field crosses the middle ground with several convincing cylindrical hay bales placed at varied depths. Place one weathered vintage red farm tractor off-centre at the lower-right rule-of-thirds intersection, facing inward toward the scene; it should be a clear secondary focal point, not oversized and never centred. Use layered depth, a subtle S-curve through the field, realistic atmospheric haze on the mountain, restrained warm sunlight, natural shadows, finely detailed bark/grass/metal, and the look of a high-end full-frame 35 mm landscape photograph. Composition must remain visually strong as one square image and support a broad top-left-to-bottom-right progressive reveal. No people, animals, buildings, signs, logos, lettering, border, collage, illustration, fantasy glow, oversaturation, excessive HDR, duplicated objects, malformed wheels, or impossible farm machinery.
